question: Why is a tuple often preferred over a list for dictionary keys or tensor shapes?
englishAnswer: Tuples are immutable and hashable (when elements are hashable), so they can safely act as dict keys or set elements and signal fixed structural dimensions.
hinglishAnswer: Tuple immutable aur hashable hota hai, isliye ise dict keys ke roop mein use kar sakte hain aur ye fixed dimensions (jaise shape) dikhata hai.

question: Difference between __str__ and __repr__, and why does __call__ matter in AI frameworks?
englishAnswer: __repr__ targets developers with unambiguous object representation; __str__ formats readable output. __call__ allows instances (like PyTorch layers or LangChain Runnables) to behave as callable functions while keeping internal weights/state.
hinglishAnswer: __repr__ developer debugging ke liye hota hai aur __str__ end-user display ke liye. __call__ ki wajah se PyTorch layers/models ko state store karte hue seedha layer(x) ki tarah call kar sakte hain.

question: When should an AI backend use asyncio vs multiprocessing?
englishAnswer: Use asyncio for I/O-bound workloads (calling OpenAI/Gemini APIs, Vector DB HTTP queries, streaming SSE) where Python spends 95% time waiting on network. Use multiprocessing or C-backed NumPy/PyTorch for CPU-bound Python loops.
hinglishAnswer: Network wait wale kaam (LLM APIs, Vector DB, DB queries) ke liye asyncio best hai. Pure CPU computation (bina NumPy ke) ke liye multiprocessing use karein.

question: Why do we subtract max(x) before computing Softmax?
englishAnswer: Because exp(x) grows exponentially and overflows float32 (~exp(89) = inf -> NaN). Since softmax(x - c) == softmax(x) mathematically, subtracting max(x) keeps exponents <= 0.
hinglishAnswer: exp(x) float32 mein jaldi infinity (aur phir NaN) ban jata hai. Mathematically softmax(x - max) barabar hota hai, aur sab values <= 0 rehne se overflow nahi hota.

question: How do you handle a classification dataset where only 2% of rows are positive?
englishAnswer: Use Stratified train/test split, evaluate with PR-AUC / Recall@K / F1 instead of accuracy, set class_weight="balanced" or scale_pos_weight, and tune the probability decision threshold.
hinglishAnswer: Stratified split karein, metric Accuracy ki jagah F1 ya PR-AUC rakhein, class_weight="balanced" lagayein aur business cost ke hisaab se classification threshold tune karein.

question: What happens if you forget `optimizer.zero_grad()` in PyTorch?
englishAnswer: PyTorch accumulates gradients by adding into `.grad` by default (useful for gradient accumulation over micro-batches), so omitting zero_grad corrupts updates with stale gradients from prior steps.
hinglishAnswer: PyTorch gradients ko overwrite nahi karta balki `.grad` mein add karta rehta hai. `zero_grad()` na karne par pichle batches ke gradients judte rahenge aur training bigad jayegi.

question: Why does Transformer memory/compute scale quadratically O(T^2) with context length?
englishAnswer: Because Q @ K^T computes an attention score matrix of shape (T, T) between every pair of tokens. FlashAttention fuses tiled SRAM blocks to avoid writing the full T×T matrix to slow HBM GPU memory.
hinglishAnswer: Har token baaki sab T tokens se dot product karta hai, jisse T×T matrix banta hai. FlashAttention GPU SRAM tiling se iski memory overhead dramatically kam karta hai.

question: When should you choose Hybrid RAG over LoRA Fine-Tuning?
englishAnswer: Choose RAG when knowledge changes frequently, requires strict source citations, or per-user access permissions. Choose LoRA when teaching formatting, specialized domain tone, classification accuracy, or distilling prompts into a smaller fast model.
hinglishAnswer: Jab data roz badalta ho ya source citations chahiye hon tab RAG best hai. Jab style, JSON format, ya chhote model par domain specialization chahiye tab LoRA use karein.

question: What is Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and why use it instead of normalizing raw BM25 and Cosine scores?
englishAnswer: BM25 scores are unbounded (e.g. 0 to 40) while cosine similarity is in [-1, 1], making raw score addition unstable. RRF fuses purely by ordinal rank `1 / (k + rank)`, staying scale-invariant.
hinglishAnswer: BM25 aur Cosine scores ka scale bilkul alag hota hai, isliye unhe seedhe add nahi kar sakte. RRF rank position (`1/(k+rank)`) par combine karta hai jo clean aur stable hai.

question: When is an Autonomous Agent the WRONG choice compared to a fixed workflow?
englishAnswer: When steps are predictable and fixed (e.g., extract -> classify -> store in DB). A deterministic Python workflow + 2 structured LLM calls is 5× cheaper, faster, and far easier to debug than an autonomous agent.
hinglishAnswer: Jab steps fixed aur predictable hon (extract -> classify -> save), tab deterministic workflow + LLM calls agents ke muqable 5x saste, fast aur reliable hote hain.

question: How do you prevent indirect prompt injection in a RAG system over external emails or PDFs?
englishAnswer: Treat retrieved chunks strictly as untrusted data inside delimited blocks, never give the summarizing LLM write/delete tool access without user confirmation, and scan outputs for unexpected URLs or leaked tokens.
hinglishAnswer: Retrieved PDF/web text ko untrusted data maan kar delimiter tags mein rakhein, destructive tools ko bina user approval ke mat chalayein, aur output scan karein.

question: In a system design interview, how do you cut latency and cost of an AI agent pipeline by 70%?
englishAnswer: 1) Add semantic caching for repeated intents; 2) Route simple queries to fast Flash/8B models instead of frontier reasoning models; 3) Trim RAG chunks using reranking (top-5 instead of top-20); 4) Stream tokens immediately and parallelize independent tool calls via asyncio.
hinglishAnswer: 1) Semantic cache lagayein; 2) Easy queries ko fast Flash/SLM model par route karein; 3) Reranker se prompt chunks kam karein; 4) Asyncio se parallel tool calls + token streaming use karein.
